Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for running the POC with our team last week. We had some unexpected internal delays (security sign-off + data mapping) that cut into our evaluation window. The engineers are still running synthetic tests and we've identified two additional feature asks that will add another 7-10 business days to a meaningful trial.

Given the delays, Avenport would like to request:
- A two-week extension to the POC window
- An additional 50k free inference credits to cover the expanded test scope
- A one-time pilot discount (we were hoping for ~25% off list for the first 3 months if we convert)

We have a PO form ready to go pending commercial confirmation. If Redwood can accommodate the combined credit + discount, we can sign and aim to convert to a reserved capacity commitment in Q4. I attached a short usage report from our runs.

Can you confirm next steps and whether this needs exec approval?

Best,
Evan Brooks

Hi Evan — thanks for the context and for sharing the usage report. I’m glad the team is still making progress even with the delays.

Short answer: we can accommodate an extension and a bundle, but the scale you’re asking for (50k credits + 25% discount) exceeds my standard approval limits — I’ll need exec signoff for a combined concession.

What I can do right away:
- Approve a two-week extension to the POC start/end dates (no exec needed)
- Offer a baseline supplemental credit of 5k free credits while we escalate the larger ask

To move the larger ask forward I’m escalating with our commercial leadership and Finance. If you’re comfortable, please go ahead and share a PO placeholder (we can make the concession contingent on PO by 2026-09-30). I’m attaching the current SOW for reference.

I’ll follow up once I have a decision from leadership (aiming EOD tomorrow).

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Forwarding Avenport’s ask (thread below). Quick summary: they hit internal delays and are requesting a two-week extension + 50k supplemental inference credits + a 25% pilot discount for first 3 months if they convert. They signaled willingness to convert to reserved capacity in Q4 if we can provide the bundle and PO comes through.

Why I’m escalating:
- 50k credits at our marginal token cost equates to ~ $38k in unit spend (if used); a 25% discount across first quarter materially reduces expected ARR for small deal.
- Strategic match: Avenport is evaluating Redwood for a cross-product deployment (security/compliance is a blocker we can help resolve), potential multi-region expansion.

Proposed commercial compromise (my recommendation):
- Grant 30k supplemental credits (one-time)
- Offer a 20% pilot discount for 3 months, conditional on a signed PO and a 6-month committed conversion conversation (not a legal commitment, but commercial alignment)
- Require PO by 2026-09-30 and SOW amendment (SOW link: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-avenport-sow)

Attachments: pricing redline with impact analysis (Pricing_Redline_Avenport.docx). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/AVP-2026-0432

Can you review and sign off quickly? Avenport is on a short timeline and procurement is ready once we confirm.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Kim — thanks for the clear ask and the proposed compromise. I’m comfortable with making a concession to keep momentum, but I want to tighten the exposure a bit.

My suggested revise:
- Supplemental credits: 30k one-time (agree)
- Pilot discount: approve up to 15% for first 3 months (rather than 20%)
- Include a commercial clause: if they don’t move toward a term commitment by end of Q4, discount recoupment or a credit offset conversation to be triggered (we can discuss exact language with Legal)

If Marissa is OK with this I’ll greenlight. We should flag Finance to record the concession as an approved deal-level adjustment.
